sources.title: OpenLearn Beginners’ Chinese: Translating foreign names
sources.author: The Open University
sources.note: Cultural/linguistic evidence for multiple Chinese strategies for foreign names: sound-based character choices, meaning-based choices, mixed strategies, and Chinese name order when a Chinese family-name equivalent is adopted. Use as authored lesson evidence, not copied instructional text.

sources.title: Lifeprint: Name Signs in American Sign Language
sources.author: William Vicars
sources.note: Cultural evidence that ASL names may be fingerspelled and that community name signs are generally assigned through participation in the Deaf community rather than self-invented by outsiders.
